description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home! * 6 Bikes Available* FREE Seasonal Tram Service to the Beach and Pool * 5 Minute Walk to Seacrest Beach Access * Multiple Balconies and Patios* Huge 12,000sqft Community Resort Style Pool * Snorkel the Grouper Reef- more info under Area Attractions below* Walk to Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach! * Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service *This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under 25. No Exceptions.***The Lagoon Pool will be resurfaced. This project will take approximately 4 weeks. Start date on this process is Monday, Oct 27th, 2025. The pool deck will be closed during this time as well due to the safety hazards during this project. We anticipate opening the complex on Monday, November 24th, 2025. During this time, our Neighbors at the Village of South Walton will be allowing the use of our wristbands at their pool complex. ***Parking passes will be provided equally to the number of bedrooms in the home. Not all parking spots are located directly by the home. Additional passes may be purchased for $50 each. Wristbands are required for use of the Seacrest Beach amenities and are limited to the maximum occupancy of the home.*Welcome to Dragonfly Dreams 30A, a stunning three-story coastal retreat nestled in the charming Seacrest Beach neighborhood. After a day of sun and fun, unwind on the upstairs porch swing or relax in the spacious living room while watching your favorite movie. The family chef will be in paradise in the fully-equipped kitchen, perfect for preparing delicious meals. The first floor features Guest Bedroom 1 with a comfortable queen bed. On the second floor, you'll find the luxurious king master suite with an ensuite bathroom, complete with a soaking tub and walk-in shower. There are also two additional guest bedrooms—Guest Bedroom 2 with a full bed, and Guest Bedroom 3 with two twin beds. Head up to the third floor, where the kids will love the two sets of twin bunk beds and a convenient half bath. For some fun outside, take the family to the large community pool or hop on the seasonal tram for a quick ride to the gorgeous beaches. Dragonfly Dreams 30A is sure to become a beloved family tradition!Seacrest Beach Community is perfectly nestled between Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach on Hwy 30A. This luxury development offers an array of amenities including deeded beach access just across the street, a huge 12,000sqft community lagoon pool, an amphitheater, seasonal tram service to the beach or pool, and 1.35 miles of walking trails! The convenient location is within walking distance to world class dining, spas, wine bars, and many wonderful locally owned shops! Come see why friends and families vacation at Seacrest Beach year after year!The Bed Setup:1st FloorGuest Bedroom 1: Queen Bed2nd FloorMaster Bedroom: King Bed Guest Bedroom 2: Full BedGuest Bedroom 3: 2 Twin Beds3rd Floor:Guest Bedroom 4: Two Twin/Twin Bunk BedsArea Attractions:Rosemary Beach is only minutes away, with shops and restaurants, including the Old World style town center with coffee shop, bike and surf rentals, and unique shops. Check out the open-air markets on the weekends. Enjoy the beautiful sugar-white sand beaches that made 30A world famous. Enjoy walking and biking everywhere around Rosemary, Seacrest, and Alys. Don't miss the newly opened 30Avenue for even more dining and shopping options. 30Avenue is just north of Rosemary across Hwy 98, near both Shades Sports Bar and The Donut Hole.This laid back, fun family atmosphere awaits you! Come stay and play and see for yourself what makes our community and the 30A area so special!The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
